title: Security Hardening
description: Secure your SQL Server instance with authentication modes, principals, permissions, encryption, and data protection features.
longDescription: This module covers SQL Server security fundamentals including authentication modes, server and database principals, permission management with GRANT/REVOKE/DENY, Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Always Encrypted, Row-Level Security, Dynamic Data Masking, and auditing strategies to protect sensitive data.
whatYouLearn: Configure Windows Authentication and Mixed Mode authentication
Manage server and database principals (logins, users, roles)
Grant, revoke, and deny permissions at server and database levels
Implement Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) for data-at-rest protection
Configure Always Encrypted for column-level encryption
